ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.
   C. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels has no place in daily life.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   A. Use Miracles of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

   B. Say Selected Surah: has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Surah: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah:.

   A. Say Taraweeh and Witr has no place in daily life.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)

13. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

14. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)
